## Review checklist

- [ ] The change follows the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/animu-sphere/hydra-lotus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Changed behavior has relevant tests, or the reason tests are unnecessary is stated.
- [ ] User-facing changes are recorded under Unreleased in the changelog, when applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and support claims match the implementation and measured evidence.
- [ ] Added assets may be redistributed and include required licenses, when applicable.
